Authoritative, audited figures.

|   | RSUs |

| 2020 | 9,715 |
| 2021 | 6,315 |
| 2022 | 3,458 |
| 2023 | 150 |
| Total unrecognized compensation expense | $34,804 |

Stock-based compensation expense related to these awards will be different to the extent that forfeitures are realized..

Authoritative, audited figures.

|   | RSUs |
|---|---|

| 2020 | 9,715 |
| 2021 | 6,315 |
| 2022 | 3,458 |
| 2023 | 150 |
| Total unrecognized compensation expense | $34,804 |

Stock-based compensation expense related to these awards will be different to the extent that forfeitures are realized..

### Calculation

\( \frac{9,715,000}{34,804,000} \times 100 = 27.91\% \)

All figures are final and audited.
